description: This source file contains the definition of the 'Cron' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting' namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for cron jobs including adding, deleting, editing, and retrieving cron job data from the database.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing cron job entries in the database, including adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving cron jobs.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Inserts a new cron job record into the database with provided code, description, cycle, action, and status.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron job record based on its cron_id.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes cron job(s) based on a specific code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the modification date of a cron job record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific cron job identified by cron_id.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific cron job by ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single cron job record based on its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of cron jobs, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total number of cron job records in the database.
